review_evidence: README identifies Velvet as a Dafny-style foundational verifier embedded in Lean, combining SMT automation with interactive proofs, property-based testing, partial/total correctness, and nondeterministic semantics.

The primary modules include the verifier syntax/theory plus Demo and Examples programs for sorting, allocation, arithmetic, recursion, search, termination, and specifications; these examples are formal program/specification artifacts.
Example/demo provenance is not a hard-exclusion criterion under FILTER-011, and no stronger duplicate or no-content invariant was established.
summary: Retain Velvet's verifier theory and all demo/example specifications and proofs.

review_evidence: Per-file keyword count (theorem|lemma|def|abbrev|structure|inductive|class|instance|method|macro|syntax|elab|example|prove_correct|macro_rules) over all 130 files: 9 files have count 0, all others have at least 1.

Read in full the 0-count files Velvet.lean, Velvet/Core.lean, Velvet/Core/Loop.lean, Velvet/Core/NonDet.lean, Velvet/Core/Partial.lean, Velvet/Core/VCGen.lean, Velvet/Frontend.lean, Velvet/Examples.lean, CaseStudies/DataStructures/Graph/Graph.lean: public/meta import aggregators; Velvet/Core.lean and Velvet/Core/VCGen.lean also carry open commands. Retained under FILTER-007/FD-016.
Read Main.lean in full: imports Velvet and defines public def main printing a greeting; small, retained as the package entry module.
Read Velvet/Frontend/SyntaxDecls.lean in full: syntax declarations for the `method ... requires ... ensures` command and `prove_correct` command, formal interface of the verifier.

Read CaseStudies/LeetProof/CountPrimes.lean lines 1-40: Mathlib imports, primeSetBelow as a Finset filter of Nat.Prime, precondition/postcondition definitions and a Velvet method with named ensures clause.
Read Velvet/Frontend/Types.lean lines 1-30: documented structures AssertionBinder, AssertionInfo, MethodElabContext used by the method elaborator.
summary: Surveyed all 130 listed Lean files under CaseStudies/ (DataStructures/Graph, PriorityQueue, LeetProof, SegmentTree), Velvet/Core (FreerMonad, Loop, NonDet, Partial, VCGen), Velvet/Frontend, Velvet/Examples, plus Main.lean and Velvet.lean. Ran a per-file declaration-keyword count over every listed file and read all low-count outliers in full. Every file is Lean source: verified-program specifications and proofs, the Velvet verifier theory (weakest preconditions, non-determinism, partial correctness), or its elaborator/syntax/macro tooling. The nine zero-declaration files are module import aggregators; FILTER-007 keeps them primary-eligible and FD-016 ranks them as navigation, so no file is excluded. Disposition: retain all.
